label: Ok
name: ok
hint: True when the home tab was published (or the call needed nothing, like a skipped tab).

label: Error
name: error
hint: What went wrong, when something did. Empty otherwise.

label: Warnings
name: warnings
hint: Things that did not stop the step: a feature Slack refused, a table read that failed, a bad games_json.

label: Mode
name: mode
hint: home (app_home_opened) or click (a press on the home tab).

label: Action
name: action
hint: open, start, period, refresh, channel or unknown.

label: Skipped
name: skipped
hint: Why nothing was done, when nothing was: the Messages tab, a channel picked, another app's press.

label: User ID
name: user_id
hint: The person the page was published for.

label: Environment
name: env
hint: dev or prod: the DiceUp table read.

label: Period
name: period
hint: The period the stats show: 7, 30, 90 or all.

label: Published
name: published
hint: True when views.publish succeeded.

label: Look used
name: look_used
hint: The features the published page kept (plain = none), after any Slack refused.

label: Blocks
name: blocks
hint: Top-level blocks in the page (Slack allows 100).

label: View JSON
name: view_json
hint: The view as published (or previewed): {type, private_metadata, blocks}.

label: Rows read
name: rows_read
hint: Rows read from the DiceUp table.

label: Partial
name: partial
hint: True when max_pages or the time budget stopped the read: the stats cover only the rows read.

label: Games shown
name: games_shown
hint: Games on the page (coming soon included).

label: Notice
name: notice
hint: The line put at the top of the page after a press (game on its way, pick a channel, invite the app).

label: Start game
name: start_game
hint: [click] Set when Start handed a game off: its key (tambola). The recipe's IF on this runs that game's step.

label: Start text
name: start_text
hint: [click] The word to pass as `text` to the game's step (itambola).

label: Start channel
name: start_channel
hint: [click] The channel to pass as `channel` to the game's step.

label: Start user ID
name: start_user_id
hint: [click] The person to pass as `user_id` to the game's step (they become the organizer).

label: Start message ts
name: start_message_ts
hint: [click] ts of the line posted in the channel, to pass as `message_ts` (leave thread_ts blank). Empty when announce_start = no.

label: Start permalink
name: start_permalink
hint: [click] Link to that line (the Open channel button).

label: Your games
name: your_games
hint: The viewer's games played, every game, all time.

label: Your prizes
name: your_prizes
hint: The viewer's prizes won, every game, all time.

label: Your grand prizes
name: your_grand_prizes
hint: The viewer's grand prizes (Full Houses in tambola), all time.

label: Your hosted
name: your_hosted
hint: Games the viewer organized, all time.

label: Your badges
name: your_badges
hint: Achievements the viewer has earned.

label: Your stats JSON
name: your_stats_json
hint: The viewer's stats as JSON: total, badges, and per game {games, prizes, grand, hosted, rank, of}.

label: Elapsed ms
name: elapsed_ms
hint: How long the step took.
